title: Remove short trails
prompt: The club is retiring trails shorter than 6 km. Delete them from the trails table. The check looks at the table after your SQL runs, so a SELECT alone won't pass.
hints: Use DELETE FROM with a WHERE clause. Without WHERE, every row is deleted.

check.sql: SELECT id, name FROM trails ORDER BY id;

cases.name: A trail of exactly 6 km
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM trails; INSERT INTO trails VALUES (7, 'Birch Walk', 'West', 3.1, 40), (11, 'Six Mile Lane', 'East', 6.0, 75);

wrongSolutions.why: Also deletes a trail of exactly 6 km
Displays rows without changing the table
